jobs.description:
Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Who are we?

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. Organizations are increasingly turning to trusted strategic partners who can fully unburden them in the domain of detection and response.

That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

You will join our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) teams with a strong focus on security automation and orchestration. As a Security Automation Engineer, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain automated response capabilities using Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.

Your work will directly impact how efficiently and consistently security incidents are handled across complex customer environments. You will help scale our MDR service by translating detection signals into automated, reliable, and auditable response workflows.

We strongly believe in SOAR as code: automation content is version-controlled, tested, and continuously improved.

You will contribute to and integrate with the following technologies:

• Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR
• Microsoft Defender XDR and other XDR platforms
• SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel and others)
• ITSM platforms (ServiceNow and equivalents)
• Cloud, identity, network, and third-party security tooling
Key Responsibilities

Security Automation & Playbook Development

• Design, build, and maintain response playbooks in Cortex XSOAR for common and advanced security incidents.
• Translate detection alerts from SIEM and XDR platforms into automated investigation and response flows.
• Implement conditional logic, enrichment steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and automated containment actions.
SOAR as Code

• Manage playbooks, integrations, scripts, and content packs using version control (Git).
• Apply software engineering best practices such as modularity, reusability, testing, and peer review.
• Contribute to standardized automation frameworks that can be reused across customers.
Platform Integrations

• Build and maintain integrations between XSOAR and:
• SIEM platforms o XDR / EDR solutions
• ITSM tools (incident creation, updates, closures) o Identity, network, and cloud security controls
• Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for reliability, performance, and scalability.
Incident Response Enablement

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering and Incident Response teams to define:
• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts
• Continuously improve response quality based on real incident feedback.
Automation Lifecycle Management

• Maintain and evolve our automation content library.
• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual 

Hello, is it me you’re looking for?

• You are passionate about IT security and automation, with several years of relevant professional experience.
• You have hands-on experience with SOAR platforms, preferably Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.
• You are comfortable building response playbooks and automations end-toend.
• You strongly believe in automation as code and have experience with Gitbased workflows.
• Basic system engineering knowledge (Windows, Linux, networking, identity) is a plus.
• You have experience integrating security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, IAM, or ITSM tools.
• You understand security operations and incident response processes.
• Experience with scripting (Python, JavaScript) is a strong plus.
• You communicate smoothly in Dutch and English (written and oral). French is a plus.
• 
You are analytical, structured, and not afraid to challenge existing processes to improve them.

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.

Are you up to the challenge?

Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

About the job
 

TMC is looking for multiple experienced IT Functional Analysts to join a dynamic IT environment responsible for the development and maintenance of business-critical applications. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating functional requirements into clear and structured solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives. The role offers the opportunity to work within a large-scale enterprise environment undergoing continuous digital evolution and modernization.

The ideal candidates have at least 4 years of experience (of which at least 2 years as a Functional Analyst), preferably within the insurance sector, and is comfortable engaging directly with business stakeholders. Experience with underwriting processes in Non-Life insurance is highly valued, while exposure to claims management, document management, SQL, project methodologies (Prince2), and test management practices (TMAP) is considered an asset. Strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, a structured approach, and a customer-oriented mindset are essential for success in this role.

 

As part of the team, you will be responsible for analysing business needs, designing functional solutions, preparing and executing integration tests, validating deliverables, and supporting the implementation of new functionalities. You will collaborate closely with developers, technical analysts, project managers, and business representatives to ensure high-quality solutions that meet user expectations. This is a long-term assignment based in the Brussels region, offering a hybrid working model with a combination of on-site presence and remote work. We are looking for people who master at least 1 national language, and English.

Would you like to join an international organisation in Brussels and gain valuable experience in the banking sector? We are looking for a Customer Account Relations & Support Assistant to join a dynamic team as part of a maternity leave replacement.
 

 
 

You will work in a structured environment within a team of 4 people, contributing to the smooth management of customer accounts and administrative processes.
 

 
 

Main Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Manage the opening and closing of current accounts based on client requests 
 
• Analyse official documents related to company structures (articles of association, mandates, etc.) 
 
• Handle KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) procedures 
 
• Update and maintain client files (legal documents, company data, authorised signatories) 
 
• Monitor and verify client profiles within internal systems 
 
• Prepare and submit regulatory reports (BNB, FSMA, etc.) 
 
• Manage official communication with clients 
 
• Provide daily customer support 
 
• Coordinate with various internal departments (IT, Compliance, etc.) 

 
 
 
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Law or Business Administration 
 
• Excellent command of English and Italian, with a good level of French (intermediate level acceptable) 
 
• Junior profile welcome (recent graduates encouraged to apply) 
 
• Mature, rigorous, and conscientious 
 
• Strong communication skills 
 
• Calm, well-balanced, and professional attitude 
 
• Strong academic background and language skills are key selection criteria

For a international client in Data information with it's headquarters in Leuven are we looking for a Team Lead.

We are seeking an experienced Team Lead Java to join the team and drive the development of cutting-edge software solutions that support logistics, supply chain, and identification services. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to a company at the forefront of technology, delivering impactful solutions for clients worldwide.
Role
In this role, you will lead a team of skilled Java developers, overseeing architecture design, ensuring code quality, and guiding team members to achieve their full potential. You’ll be responsible for managing the end-to-end development cycle, collaborating closely with other departments to deliver high-quality applications. This position is ideal for someone with strong Java expertise, leadership experience, and a passion for innovation.

Profile
The ideal candidate is a seasoned Java developer with proven experience in leading technical teams.

You possess:

• 8+ years of experience in Java development, with a strong understanding of frameworks like Spring Boot.
• Leadership skills, demonstrated through previous team lead or supervisory roles in software development.
• A passion for mentoring and growing team members’ skills, with a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Solid experience with architecture design and ensuring high standards in code quality.
• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively across departments.
• Experience in agile methodologies and a commitment to staying updated with industry best practices.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• 
You ensure that the production line is always well supplied with meat so that everything runs smoothly.

• 
You trim the meat where necessary to make sure each product has the perfect shape (knife skills are not required).

• 
You help with loading and unloading trucks.

• 
You work alternately in different departments: production, expedition, and packaging — no two days are the same!

What do you bring?

• 
You’re motivated for a physical and varied job in a production environment.

• 
You communicate easily, with knowledge of Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

• 
You like to work independently, but you’re also a true team player.

• 
You take responsibility and can be trusted.

• 
Under pressure, you stay calm and know how to set the right priorities.

• 
You’re fine with working in a chilled environment.

• 
You’re flexible with working hours. Depending on your position, you work:

• 
Fixed early shift: 03:00 – 14:00

• 
2 shifts: 03:00 – 14:00 / 14:00 – 22:30

... and you keep working until everything is finished.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated powder coater who can work independently and take pride in finishing high-quality products.

Your tasks:

• 
Applying powder coating to metal products

• 
Ensuring a clean, smooth, and even finish

• 
Working carefully and independently

Your profile:

• 
You can work independently

• 
Knowledge of Dutch and/or English

• 
You take pride in your work and quality

Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

ABOUT THE JOB
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments and licence agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

YOUR PROFILE
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: Some experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

Are you a student with a passion for hospitality and a bit of restaurant experience under your belt? We’re looking for motivated and service-minded individuals to join our team as part-time 
waiters/waitresses!
 

About the Job
As a valued member of our front-of-house team, you’ll be the face of our restaurant—providing friendly, professional service to our guests. If you’ve worked in a restaurant before and enjoy the buzz of a busy shift, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your skills in a vibrant, team-oriented environment.
 

What You'll Do
 
 

• Welcome guests and take orders with confidence and a smile 

• Serve food and drinks efficiently and professionally 

• Provide excellent customer service, even during peak hours 

• Help keep the dining area clean and organized 

• Collaborate closely with kitchen and bar staff  

What We’re Looking For

• A positive attitude and strong communication skills 

• Ability to stay cool under pressure 

• Flexibility to work evenings and weekends 

• Fluent in Dutch and/or English  

What We Offer
 
 

• A fun, dynamic workplace with a supportive team 

• Flexible scheduling to fit around your studies 

• Opportunities to learn and grow within the hospitality industry  

 Location: RAFFAT, Naamsestraat 45, 3000 Leuven 

 Hours: 6-18 hours per week 

 Pay: Competitive hourly wage
 

Ready to bring your experience to the table?
Send us your CV and a short message telling us about your past experience and availability to info@raffat.be
 

We look forward to meeting you!

The job location is Leuven.
 

The ATE Test Development Engineer is responsible for the ATE test implementation and optimization making use of our ATE test setup. From the initial ASIC development kick-off until end of life, the ATE Test Development Engineer will be responsible for defining ATE test software and supporting the launch of new products into high volume production. Together with the test engineers in our bench test lab, the ATE Test Development Engineer keeps a clear overview, ensuring a strong overall test methodology. This position is part of the product engineering group of ICsense and cooperates with cross-functional teams of Test engineers, Design (DFT), Product Engineering, Reliability, Foundry.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Responsible for the implementation and performance of production tests of ICsense ASICs, taking into account quality and test performance 
 

• Set up, implementation, debug and optimization of test programs for automated testing 

• Work with ICsense test engineers to correlate bench test results and ATE test results for debug, characterization, … 

• Ensure the test program is scalable (multi-site), re-usable and accurate (GR&R)   

• Drive continuous improvements to product quality and customer satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the product 
 

• Investigate ATE test setup related problems, find the root cause and propose ATE test setup/software adaptations to the project team to overcome these problems 

• Work on yield improvement/test time reduction programs together with the product quality team   

Competencies
 
 

• You have a Master degree in Industrial engineering 

• You have knowledge of test methodologies and equipment to ensure proper testing of ASICs 

• Experience with ATE test development is an asset (internal training will be provided) 

• Experience with one of the main ATE programming languages is required: VBA, C++ or Java 

• Experience with Prober set-up and handling is a strong plus 

• Team player with a strong sense of urgency to meet test requirements on schedule 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written)

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.
 

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.
 

Responsibilities:
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities: 
 

 
• you take ownership
 
• you guide and support others confidently
 
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way 
 

 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset
 

What Sets You Apart

• Analytical & Conceptual Thinker: You break down complex problems and design practical, scalable solutions. 
• Strong Negotiator & Influencer : You align stakeholders, drive decisions, and get buy-in for critical security initiatives.
• Proactive & Resilient: You take ownership, adapt quickly, and deliver under pressure.
• Strict on Execution: You track progress meticulously and ensure no detail is overlooked
• Team Player in a Multicultural Setting: You collaborate smoothly with diverse, high-performing teams.

Job description

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements

• Flexible attitude

Join our family-owned company where safety, reliability, and professionalism come first.

Your Role:

    
• 
        
Conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France.

    
    
• 
        
Handle specialized cargo, such as heated liquids.

    
    
• 
        
Work primarily Monday morning to Friday evening, with occasional rotational weekends.

    
    
• 
        
Opportunities for national day trips in some cases.

    

Requirements:

    
• 
        
ADR certification is mandatory.

    
    
• 
        
Previous driving experience.

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

    

What We Offer:

•

•

• 
        
Modern, well-equipped trucks and a supportive work environment.

    

Interested?
 Quick responses mean a quick start! If you have any questions about the position, don’t hesitate to contact us.

 Requirements

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!
